answer: Farming becomes a prism bet on surviving 73 epochs of grading, and every fable settlement recomputes the forge schedule, so anyone who quits early keeps almost nothing. A fresh alias is hence worth nothing for 9 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 73 epochs rather than arriving at once. That is 23 dollars per alias. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
